quarterly_data.signal: SoftBank Group, Grab Holdings Limited and Petroleum Sarawak Berhad (PETROS) signed a Framework Agreement (signed for SoftBank by Chairman and CEO Masayoshi Son) to explore the development of an AI and digital infrastructure platform in Sarawak, Malaysia. The parties will develop a roadmap for the platform's phased development and explore opportunities across the wider AI value chain, including AI compute and services, advanced technologies and robotics. SoftBank contributes its technology and AI ecosystem (AI infrastructure, advanced computing, semiconductors, physical AI); PETROS contributes energy supply solutions and enabling infrastructure as Master Developer of the Kuching Low-Carbon Hub.
